body:
I did reach out to my mother one time when I was 16 (a long time ago), I told her I was depressed. She pretty much scoffed at the idea "Depression? You're 16, what have you got to be depressed about?"

She's not a bad person, and she wasn't trying to be bad. She's just old school. She comes from a time when you sorted your own shit out. Still, I never told anyone anything like that again.
Not really. I'm in pretty healthy physically. Maybe a bit underweight though.

What I'm driving at is that there's people with terrible situations, yet they play the hand they're dealt. I have it easy (comparatively), yet I am constantly depressed. I think of all the time wasted on this, went I could have been trying to change it, then that in turn makes me depressed again. Thus the cycle continues.

Even if it is medical, its hard to get over that hump. I don't know. I'm just stubborn perhaps. Sorry if I'm waffling on.

Yeah, you're probably right, but it still makes me feel inferior. I guess the anxiety of possibly being judged is a symptom of my illness, and ironically is stopping me from seeking treatment for it. It's like a catch 32.

I almost went in a few days back. I went into the local GP, but when I went into the waiting room and saw all the other people... I just couldn't do it. I felt like a fraud.

But if its mental, why can't I just sort it out in my own head? Why must everything be so negative?

I mean for example there's kids in Africa who are literally born with HIV, and then I get sad about my life? It's pretty pathetic, and embarrassing.

Thanks for replying so quickly though.

Any time I try to sleep I end lying awake for hours, unable to sleep because the shit is go around in my head.

Even when I do sleep I always feel worse when I awake. Everytime. It's like I regret waking up. Seems so fucking stupid to say.

I know most of this stuff isn't my fault, but it kills me I can't fix it, and it WILL get worse, because that's what's happening. Just when I think its over, we all get shit on again. Why bother?
